prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: polished blue-grey marble floor tiles of an academic city, fine veins, thin gold inlay lines The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: polished blue-grey marble floor tiles of an academic city, fine restrained marble veins and thin gold inlay lines delineating stonework. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand placed pixels, crisp uniform square art pixels (roughly 7–8 display pixels per art pixel), no antialiasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic textures, no noise, no checkerboard dithering. Deliberate clusters of 3–10 art pixels with clearly shaped details. 4–6 shades per material, hue-shifted palette: blue-grey base, deeper saturated purple-red shadow notes, warm-yellow highlights in gold and subtle marble glints; earthy, rich, worn and lived-in. Orthographic directly top-down classic RPG map view, no perspective convergence. Neutral soft even illumination from upper left as on a calm overcast evening: clean base colours, no cast shadows, no nighttime darkening, no glowing or light sources or vignette. Precise seamless periodic repeat: patterns, grout lines, stone veins and inlay crossing left/right and top/bottom boundaries must line up when tiled. Entire square edge to edge is surface only, no border, frame, objects, characters, text or focal feature. Even distribution of detail.
